title: VITAdev experiment: unchanged Plus baseline
purpose: Establish Jak and Uncharted visual behavior using the unchanged all-enhancements emulator and Android frontend.
device_checks: Install over VITAdev and confirm that settings, saves and the imported Vulkan driver remain available.
Use the same actual Vulkan driver, save, camera, resolution and memory mapping as Vita3K-Plus.
Check Jak's sky, terrain, water and HUD, and Uncharted's black rectangle, lighting and shadows.
After shader compilation finishes, restart and repeat the same scenes. Record the driverID line and paired screenshots.
